name: Kashiwara crystal bases
summary: Crystal bases give combinatorial skeleton of quantum group representations.

name: PCP theorem: proofs, coding theory and hardness of approximation
summary: Low-degree polynomial codes let a verifier check proofs by reading a few bits, which implies that many optimisation problems cannot be approximated.

name: Sensitivity conjecture
summary: Huang's signed hypercube adjacency matrix and eigenvalue interlacing settled the sensitivity conjecture in a page.

name: Ramsey-theoretic dichotomies in Banach space theory
summary: Infinite Ramsey theory and descriptive set theory are used to prove dichotomies for Banach spaces and to construct spaces answering the unconditional basic sequence problem.

name: Modularity and FLT
summary: Wiles and Taylor-Wiles proved modularity of semistable elliptic curves via Hecke algebra patching, giving Fermat's Last Theorem.

name: Elliptic curve and pairing-based cryptography
summary: Weil/Tate pairings on elliptic curves enabled new cryptographic protocols such as identity-based encryption.

name: Floer theory and Fukaya categories (Lagrangian Floer)
summary: Lagrangian intersection Floer theory was organised into an A-infinity category; Fukaya-Oh-Ohta-Ono gave a rigorous foundation.

name: Fourier restriction method for nonlinear dispersive PDE (Bourgain)
summary: Restriction estimates from harmonic analysis, with lattice-point counts, give well-posedness of nonlinear Schroedinger and KdV equations in rough spaces.

name: K-stability and Kahler-Einstein metrics on Fano manifolds
summary: An algebraic-geometric stability condition is shown to be equivalent to existence of Kahler-Einstein metrics.

name: Tracy-Widom distributions and universality in random matrices
summary: The Airy kernel gives the edge fluctuation law of random matrices, later shown to be universal across ensembles.
